covers: Tuesday 17 November 2026 US session close and SA overnight, to 06:00 SAST Wednesday
headline: Wall Street closed about 1% lower before Nvidia's results; SA October CPI out this morning, SARB decides on Thursday
summary: The JSE All Share closed 0.8% lower at 110,616 on Tuesday and the rand was at R16.95/$ early on Wednesday, about 1.2% weaker than Friday (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17-18 Nov 2026). In New York the S&P 500 closed 1.0% lower at 7,341 and the Nasdaq 0.7% lower at 24,328, with Nvidia reporting after the bell; the LRC News Desk will publish its figures once checked against the company release. Gold closed 2.1% lower at $3,797 and platinum 4.4% lower at $1,410, a drag on JSE miners, while today's October CPI and Thursday's SARB decision (repo 7.25%) are the main local tests.

items.title: S&P 500 closes 1.0% lower at 7,341; Nasdaq -0.7% at 24,328
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed at 7,340.53 against Monday's 7,416.59 (-1.0%) and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,328.38 against 24,509.76 (-0.7%). Both finished above their 20:41 SAST levels in the Evening update but remain about 3% below Friday 13 November (S&P 7,561.67; Nasdaq 25,136.27).
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), closes 17 Nov 2026 (read 18 Nov 2026 05:58 SAST); Monday close 16 Nov 2026; Friday close 13 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield at 5.10%
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.103% on Tuesday, against 5.121% on Monday and 5.154% on Friday. The October FOMC minutes are due on Wednesday.

items.title: October CPI today, SARB on Thursday
items.summary: Stats SA publishes October CPI on Wednesday 18 November (September: 4.5%; core 4.0%). The SARB announces its decision on Thursday 19 November with the repo rate at 7.25% after September's 25bp hike. A Reuters poll quoted on Monday expected October CPI at 5.1%.
items.source: LRC Macro Desk (Stats SA, SARB), 17 Nov 2026; Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:56 GMT

items.title: Platinum -4.4% to $1,410; gold -2.1% to $3,797; Brent $92.57
items.summary: Tuesday closes: platinum $1,410.00 (Monday $1,474.20, -4.4%); gold futures $3,797.00 (Monday $3,878.60, -2.1%); Brent $92.57 (Monday $91.71, +0.9%); copper about $13,001/t (Friday about $13,403/t, -3.0%). Lower platinum and gold weigh on JSE PGM and gold miners.

items.title: Nvidia reported after Tuesday's close
items.summary: Nvidia released quarterly results after the US close on Tuesday 17 November, its first under interim CEO Colette Kress. Analysts had expected revenue up 91% to $108.93bn (TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026). The LRC News Desk has not yet checked the reported figures against the company release, so none are given here; they will follow in the Midday update. Our BUY rating (fair value $262.56) is unchanged.
items.source: TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026; City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT
